display.title: Episode 352: The Blessing of a Tzaddik, Chapter 1 (Kiddush Levanah)
display.summary_short: The last chance for Kiddush Levanah this month, a listener who wrote in leads the Shema, and a new serial begins: a traveler in a snowstorm meets a mysterious young man and an old man.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 13 Kislev 5749. Uncle Yossi reminds everyone that only one day remains to bless the new moon, and explains how our Sages calculated the molad, why the moon grows until the fifteenth of the month and then shrinks, and how the heavens tell of Hashem's greatness; the order of the day is to remind anyone who has not yet said Kiddush Levanah. After the Hakochainik march, a listener who wrote asking to visit Studio 604 leads the Shema and recites one of the Twelve Pesukim with its translation. Story time begins a new serial, 'The Blessing of a Tzaddik'. Hashem gave Avraham Avinu the power to bless, and the tzaddikim of every generation carry it on; a tzaddik's brachah is like rain, which helps only soil that has been prepared, so we prepare with mitzvos. Reb Boruch arrives at an inn past midnight in a blinding snowstorm and finds an old man asleep by the fire, when a young man comes downstairs and sharply orders the old man to get up and serve the guest. Who is that young man? The chapter ends with the question. Closing notes offer the Storytime tapes for Chanukah and give Shabbos candle time.
display.lesson: A tzaddik's blessing is like rain: to receive it in full we must prepare ourselves with mitzvos, and we should treasure every mitzvah, even blessing the new moon.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: 'today is Yud-Gimmel Kislev' and Shabbos candles on Friday 25 November.

sources_cited.note: 'The heavens tell the glory of Hashem'; 'How great are Your works'.
Hashem sets the stars in their places, said every evening.
'And you shall be a blessing', with Rashi: the blessings are placed in your hand.
The blessings are given into Avraham's hand.

relations.note: The story intro and chapter 1 (about 916-1610 s) match episode 127's chapter 1 word for word, including the same ASR slips; a rebroadcast of the same recording.
